C0081.title: Jiangsu Police Dismantle 'Traffic Hijacking' Computer Information System Sabotage Case in Internet Cafes
C0081.summary: An investigation by the cyber security division of Jiangsu police revealed that suspects Chen and Li co-developed a hacking program and colluded with internet cafe operation staff to illegally implant it in nearly 200,000 computers across 5,000 internet cafes in 20 provinces and cities.
